name: Platform Adoption
description: Adoption and leverage of internal platform libraries across the organization's Go repositories. Measures how shared infrastructure (agent frameworks, utilities, tooling) is standardized, consumed, and creates leverage.

narratives.title: Why platform adoption matters
narratives.body: Every team building infrastructure from scratch is duplicating effort and diverging from proven patterns. Platform libraries encode best practices once and let every adopter benefit from fixes, optimizations, and new capabilities. Measuring adoption via dependency analysis makes the platform story concrete: we know exactly which repos consume which libraries, and can track adoption growth over time. High adoption with low conformance signals integration problems; low adoption signals discovery or onboarding gaps.

dimensions.name: Platform Library Lifecycle
dimensions.description: The journey of a platform library from inception to widespread leverage.

stages.name: Foundation
stages.description: Library exists with clear API, documentation, and versioning.

stages.name: Adoption
stages.description: Teams discover and integrate the library into their services.

stages.name: Conformance
stages.description: Adopters use the library correctly per documented patterns.

stages.name: Leverage
stages.description: Shared improvements benefit all adopters; patterns compound.

stages.name: Evolution
stages.description: Breaking changes are managed; deprecations are smooth.

capabilities.name: Core Utilities Adoption
capabilities.description: Adoption of foundational utility libraries (mogo, gohttp, etc.) that provide common patterns for error handling, HTTP clients, configuration, and data structures.

metrics.name: Core utilities library exists
metrics.description: The mogo library provides documented, tested utilities for common Go patterns.

target.description: Library exists with godoc, tests, and semver

metrics.name: Repos importing mogo
metrics.description: Percentage of organization Go repositories that directly depend on github.com/grokify/mogo.

metrics.name: Repos importing gohttp
metrics.description: Percentage of organization Go repositories that directly depend on github.com/grokify/gohttp.

capabilities.name: AI Agent Framework Adoption
capabilities.description: Adoption of the omniagent framework for building AI-powered agents with consistent patterns for tool handling, context management, and model integration.

metrics.name: Agent framework exists
metrics.description: The omniagent library provides a documented, tested framework for building AI agents.

target.description: Framework exists with godoc, tests, and examples

metrics.name: Repos importing omniagent
metrics.description: Count of organization Go repositories that directly depend on github.com/plexusone/omniagent.

metrics.name: Shared tools across agents
metrics.description: Number of tool implementations in omniagent/tools that are reused by multiple agent projects.

metrics.name: Initiative tracking system exists

metrics.name: Repositories tracked in VisionStudio
metrics.description: Number of repositories registered and actively tracked in VisionStudio.

metrics.name: Initiatives with ROADMAP.md
metrics.description: Percentage of tracked initiatives that have a structured ROADMAP.md with RMIs.

capabilities.name: Git Tooling Adoption
capabilities.description: Adoption of gogit for repository scanning, dependency analysis, and commit statistics.

metrics.name: Git tooling library exists
metrics.description: The gogit library provides repository discovery, commit parsing, and dependency analysis.

metrics.name: Repos importing gogit
metrics.description: Count of organization Go repositories that directly depend on github.com/grokify/gogit.

metrics.name: Repos with gitscan in CI

metrics.name: SCALE framework exists

metrics.description: Number of SCALE domains with active capabilities and metrics.

metrics.name: SCALE assessments per quarter

capabilities.name: Dependency Health
capabilities.description: Cross-cutting metrics on dependency hygiene across the organization's Go repositories.

metrics.name: Repos without replace directives
metrics.description: Percentage of Go repositories with no local replace directives in go.mod.

metrics.name: Repos with matching module names
metrics.description: Percentage of Go repositories where go.mod module name matches the directory structure.

metrics.name: Release order automated
metrics.description: Whether gitscan order is used to determine correct release order for interdependent modules.

metrics.name: Dependency conflicts per quarter
metrics.description: Count of incidents caused by version conflicts or incompatible transitive dependencies.

capabilities.name: Platform Leverage
capabilities.description: Cross-cutting metrics measuring the compound value created by platform adoption.

metrics.name: Internal dependency ratio
metrics.description: Average ratio of internal (organization) dependencies to external dependencies per repository.

target.description: 30% of deps are internal platform libs

metrics.name: Lines of code reused via platform libs
metrics.description: Estimated lines of code not written because platform libraries provide the functionality.

metrics.name: Bugs fixed once, benefit all
metrics.description: Count of bugs fixed in platform libraries that automatically benefited all adopters via version bump.
